newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritian rupee steady vs the dollar and stg.
newsitem.headline: Mauritian rupee steady vs the dollar and stg.

text.p: The Mauritian rupee was steady against both dollar and sterling on Wednesday reflecting international market trends, foreign exchange dealers said.
The rupee was fixed at a commercial mean rate of 20.6295 to the dollar from 20.6165 on Tuesday, and at a commercial mean rate of 33.742 to the sterling from 33.732 on Tuesday.
Forex dealers said the dollar's strengthening was due to the left-wing victory in French parliamentary elections on Sunday.
They added that United States jobs data would be published on Friday and the dollar's fixing on international markets could be influenced positively or negatively by these figures.
Forex dealers said that some commercial banks were showing sign of hard currency shortage positions.
